approved: Road Vehicle Standards (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Amendment Bill 2022
Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development and Communications

Labor supported the government's request for a further extension to the Road Vehicle Standards Bill, originally passed in 2018, but criticised the government's incompetence and repeated delays, noting the bill has been extended twice and still lacks proper implementation, IT systems and industry consultation.
